name: Alder-Bridge Watchman's Edge
flavor: Notched along the spine from parrying river-raider boarding axes.
inspect: Carried by the last sergeant who held the southern pier of Alder Bridge until the spring flood washed away his garrison's pay-chest.

name: Garrick's Sluice-Lid
flavor: Swollen oak boards banded with an iron wagon-tire.
inspect: Hammered together by a Thornwick miller who defended his granary door against six starving deserters with nothing else in hand.

name: Silt-Plodder Boots
flavor: Triple-greased hide that sheds cold creek-water like duck feathers.
inspect: Worn by border scouts who spent three winters mapping every gravel bar between Thornwick and the upper fens.

name: Willow-Creek String
flavor: Twisted sinew cord rubbed with beeswax against morning mist.
inspect: Recovered from a hollow willow trunk where an outlawed forester hid his fletching tools from the baron's bailiffs.

name: Thorn-Thicket Cap
flavor: Stitched from briar-hound hide so thick even blackthorns slide off.
inspect: Tailored by a border trapper who crawled belly-flat through half a league of brambles to scout a brigand camp.

name: Punt-Pole Grips
flavor: Calloused river-hide molded to the exact curve of a bow-stave.
inspect: Originally worn by an Alder Ford ferryman who kept a shortbow dry beneath his floorboards for river pirates.

name: Border-Assessor's Oak
flavor: Carved with imperial survey notches that glow faintly near ley-water.
inspect: Left behind by an academy cartographer who went mad trying to measure the shifting banks of the Redwater.

name: Ditch-Chapel Prism
flavor: Bubbled river-sand glass that refracts a single spark into three.
inspect: Salvaged from the melted stained-glass window of a roadside shrine torched during the first border tax riots.

name: Hedge-Tutor's Hat
flavor: Wide felt brim stiffened with river-clay and old candle wax.
inspect: Belonged to an itinerant hedge-mage who taught farmboys their letters in exchange for dry barn-lofts and cider.

name: Silt-Picker's Willow
flavor: Peeled river-willow bound with yellowed catgut and fish-vertebrae.
inspect: Used by a Thornwick bone-grinder to coax drowned livestock out of deep mudholes before they spoiled the wells.

name: Lime-Ditch Cassock
flavor: Hemmed with coarse hemp twine and dusted permanently with quicklime.
inspect: Worn by a border parish sexton who buried forty skirmish dead in a single night and swore half of them whispered back.

name: Gallows-Root Band
flavor: Whittled from a sheep's knucklebone found beneath the Crooked Willow.
inspect: Passed among border deserters as a lucky charm until every man who wore it ended up back at the same crossroads.

name: Dike-Breaker's Broadaxe
flavor: Pitted dark iron that holds a vicious, jagged edge in wet peat.
inspect: Forged from bog-ore dredged out of Redmarsh trenches to chop through submerged timber barricades during the fen rebellion.

name: Mire-Watch Ring Mail
flavor: Every iron link boiled in pine-pitch to keep the black rot out.
inspect: Stripped from a sunken sentinel whose drowned corpse still stood upright at his post three seasons after the garrison fell.

name: Boardwalk Pavise
flavor: Slotted near the top so a pikeman can thrust without raising his chin.
inspect: Carried by Redmarsh plank-guards who held narrow log causeways against swarms of fever-maddened marsh heretics.

name: Sedge-Bank Recurve
flavor: Laminated horn limbs wrapped in mottled plague-toad skin.
inspect: Favored by fenland guides who hunted bloated bog-beasts from flat-bottomed punts in thick morning fog.

name: Fen-Wader Striders
flavor: Soles pegged with bog-oak spikes that bite cleanly into slick peat.
inspect: Cured in bitter willow-tanning liquor so swamp leeches drop off the leather before reaching the laces.

name: Midge-Veil Hood
flavor: Fine horsehair mesh sewn across the mouth to filter foul marsh-gas.
inspect: Worn by Redmarsh bounty hunters tracking heretic preachers through stagnant pools where a deep breath burns the throat.

name: False-Light Crozier
flavor: A rusted iron cage at the tip traps a pale, shivering marsh-flame.
inspect: Crafted by an exiled scholar who spent seven years bottling swamp-gas spirits until one agreed to burn without fuel.

name: Bog-Crystal Lens
flavor: Cloudy river-quartz veined with threads of tarnished bog-copper.
inspect: Dredged from the cellar of a sunken abbey where monks once tried to distill clean drinking water from toxic mire.

name: Apothecary's Oilcloth
flavor: Stitched with dried wormwood pockets that rattle with every step.
inspect: Worn by Redmarsh fever-doctors who walked the quarantine trenches long after the parish priests fled north.

name: Drowned-Bell Yew
flavor: Blackened bog-yew inlaid with a sliver of cracked bronze bell-metal.
inspect: When tapped against wet stone, it emits a muffled underwater chime that calls half-rotted corpses out of the silt.

name: Tannin-Stained Wraps
flavor: Linen strips pickled dark brown by centuries beneath acidic peat.
inspect: Unwound from a remarkably preserved bog-corpse whose fingers still twitched whenever thunder rolled over Redmarsh.

name: Frog-Bone Locket
flavor: Tarnished green bronze enclosing a tiny skull carved from marsh-chalk.
inspect: Found clutched inside the jaw of a giant plague-toad slain outside the Redmarsh stockade.

name: Harbor-Chain Morning Star
flavor: Forged from a snapped harbor-boom link studded with shipwright spikes.
inspect: Wielded by an Ironcamp dock-captain who smashed through three corsair boarding shields before his own galley sank beneath him.

name: Salt-Scoured Brigandine
flavor: Overlapping whale-oiled plates riveted onto thick seal-hide.
inspect: Built for coastal marines who fought knee-deep in freezing surf without letting rust lock their shoulder joints.

name: Breakwater Kite Shield
flavor: Curved steel face hammered with the emblem of a storm-lashed lighthouse.
inspect: Stood upright on the Ironcamp sea-wall through twelve winters of pirate broadsides and winter squalls.

name: Gale-Rigging Composite
flavor: Backed with cured shark-skin that refuses to stretch in wet sea-fog.
inspect: Taken from a mutinous crow's-nest marksman who could pick off a helmsman across eighty paces of pitching swell.

name: Wreck-Diver's Bracers
flavor: Striped with brass strips salvaged from a sunken royal pay-frigate.
inspect: Worn by cliff-scavengers who climbed wet basalt chimneys with quivers strapped tight against the gale.

name: Reef-Walker Boots
flavor: Braided hemp soles stitched over oiled calfskin for wet kelp-rocks.
inspect: Favored by coastal smugglers who outran royal dragoons across razor-sharp tidal reefs at low water.

name: Blind-Beacon Rune Staff
flavor: Charred driftwood spiral-carved with copper lightning-conductors.
inspect: Stood atop the Ironcamp cliff-tower during a winter tempest, drinking three lightning strikes without splitting.

name: Tide-Scryer's Sphere
flavor: Hollow sea-glass orb half-filled with swirling, phosphorescent brine.
inspect: Used by coastal navigators to read hidden shoals through thick fog until the tide-cultists stole it for darker auguries.

name: Deep-Current Mantle
flavor: Salt-stiffened indigo velvet embroidered with silver wave-knots.
inspect: Recovered from the locked cabin of a drowned academy envoy bound for the southern provinces.

name: Leviathan-Rib Focus
flavor: Polished sea-amber capped with a shard of fossilized leviathan tooth.
inspect: Hums like a distant foghorn whenever drowned sailors rise from the surf to answer its call.

name: Ossuary-Keeper's Cowl
flavor: Gray sailcloth weighted at the hem with salt-pitted lead net-sinkers.
inspect: Worn by the hermit who tended the Iron Coast cliff-niches, keeping the restless sea-dead from wandering into town.

name: Galley-Master's Seal
flavor: Corroded sea-gold stamped with a broken oar and a chained skull.
inspect: Cut from the swollen finger of a slaver captain whose drowned crew still rowed his shattered hull beneath the waves.

name: Pyre-Marshal's Flamberge
flavor: Wave-bladed steel quenched in boiling oil and blackened by brazier-soot.
inspect: Borne by the commander of the inner citadel guard who executed three rebel lords on the steps of the Cinder Throne.

name: Ashen Citadel Cuirass
flavor: Fluted dark steel layered with mica plates to deflect crown-fire.
inspect: Hammered in the royal gunpowder foundries for the Sovereign's personal bodyguard during the final purge of the capital.

name: Cinder-Crown Bulwark
flavor: Heavy bronze-rimmed tower face scarred by molten slag splashes.
inspect: Held the inner viaduct gate for six days against siege-mortars before its bearer finally succumbed to smoke inhalation.

name: Ember-Glass Windpiercer
flavor: Steel-backed limbs inlaid with razor-sharp splinters of volcanic glass.
inspect: Drawn only by the Sovereign's parapet marksmen, capable of punching bodkin arrows clean through knightly breastplates.

name: Inquisition Sight-Veil
flavor: Smoked-glass eye-lenses set into blackened, soot-proofed leather.
inspect: Allowed royal hunters to track fugitives through blinding ash-storms without shedding a single tear.

name: Ash-Runner Grips
flavor: Supple salamander-hide palms that never blister on hot iron rungs.
inspect: Stolen from the royal armory by a disgraced scout who scaled the burning viaducts to smuggle out his family.

name: Sovereign's Brazier Staff
flavor: Crowned with a perpetually glowing coal from the First King's hearth.
inspect: Carried by the court archmage who channeled crown-fire across the capital walls until his own robes caught ablaze.

name: Molten-Bell Astrolabe
flavor: Cast from the melted bronze of Oakhaven's great cathedral bell.
inspect: Still vibrates with a low, mournful hum whenever destructive magic is gathered within ten paces.

name: Vestments of the Last Pyre
flavor: Ashen silk woven with fine gold thread that refuses to scorch.
inspect: Found folded neatly beside an empty throne in the high spire, untouched by the soot burying the rest of the hall.

name: Inquisitor's Ash-Siphon
flavor: Charred bone shaft capped with a vial of compressed chancellery soot.
inspect: Binds the restless shades of condemned prisoners whose names were burned in the Sovereign's final purge.

name: Coronet of Cold Clinkers
flavor: Blackened iron circlet set with dull, heat-cracked bloodstones.
inspect: Worn by the royal necromancer tasked with raising fallen pyre-knights back onto the battlements during the siege.

name: Heart of the Cinder Throne
flavor: A heavy slab of vitrified slag pulsing with trapped, dying warmth.
inspect: Chiseled from the base of the royal hearth where generations of kings burned their enemies' banners.
